source: AS 3600:2018 8.2: beam shear Vu = Vuc + Vus by the general method's kv and θv (8.2.4.2) with the simplified kv and θv (8.2.4.3) in the design run; φ = 0.75 on both terms; the rest of the concrete design is the strength design with φ (no ultimate group: AS 3600 designs by capacity reduction factors on the members)

sources.shear: AS 3600:2018 8.2.4.1: Vuc = kv √f'c bv dv (√f'c <= 8 MPa), dv = max(0.9 d, 0.72 D); 8.2.5: Vus = Asv fsy.f dv cot θv / s; 8.2.3.3: Vu.max = 0.55 f'c bv dv (cot θv + cot αv)/(1 + cot² θv) = 0.2615 f'c bv dv at θv 36°, αv 90°; φ = 0.75 (Table 2.2.2)
sources.shear.simplified: AS 3600:2018 8.2.4.3: θv = 36°, kv = 0.15 with at least Asv.min, else 200/(1000 + 1.3 dv) <= 0.10 (written 153.846/(769.231 + dv)); valid for f'c <= 65 MPa, fsy <= 500 MPa, aggregate >= 10 mm
sources.shear.general: AS 3600:2018 8.2.4.2: kv = 0.4/(1 + 1500 εx) × 1300/(1000 + kdg dv), kdg = 32/(16 + dg) >= 0.8 (written sze = 32 dv/(16 + dg) >= 0.8 dv), 300 with at least Asv.min; θv = 29 + 7000 εx; εx = (M*/dv + V* + 0.5 N*)/(2 Es Ast) within -0.2e-3 and 3e-3 (the general method needs M* at the section: its terms are reported by saengine.design.compression_field_shear.general_terms; the design run uses the simplified values)
sources.shear.spacing: AS 3600:2018 8.2.12.2: s <= min(0.75 D, 500 mm), min(0.5 D, 300 mm) where V* > φVu.min; SAEngine writes them on dv (0.9 dv, 0.6 dv) and takes the close spacing where V* > 0.1 φ f'c bv dv (SAEngine practice for φVu.min)
sources.torsion: AS 3600:2018 8.3: Jt = 0.33 x² y (8.3.3), Tuc = 0.3 Jt √f'c (8.3.5), torsion neglected where T* < 0.25 φTuc and no torsion reinforcement where T*/(φTuc) + V*/(φVuc) <= 0.5 (8.3.4(a)); web crushing T*/(φTu.max) + V*/(φVu.max) <= 1.0, Tu.max = 0.2 f'c Jt (8.3.3); Tus = fsy.f (Asw/s) 2 At cot θv (8.3.5(b)), θv = 36° (cot 1.376) as the shear's simplified method; closed ties at most min(0.12 ut, 300 mm) apart (8.3.8); the longitudinal steel ΔAl = T* ut cot θv / (2 φ At fsy) (8.3.6, written as the space truss force; to verify); φ = 0.75. SAEngine shares the links linearly between the shear beyond φVuc and the torsion (the code adds the torsion links to the shear's); the slab cast with the beam is not counted in Jt (on the safe side)
sources.punching: AS 3600:2018 9.3.3: Vuo = u dom (fcv + 0.3 σcp) with fcv = 0.17 (1 + 2/βh) √f'c <= 0.34 √f'c (σcp = 0, no prestress); 9.3.4: Vu = Vuo / (1 + u M*v / (8 V* a dom)) without shear reinforcement, a the critical perimeter's side parallel to M*v; φ = 0.75. Both directions' moments added (SAEngine practice, on the safe side). Closed fitments and shearheads (9.3.4(b)-(d), 9.3.5) not laid out
sources.simplifiedWalls: AS 3600:2018 11.5: φNu = φ (tw - 1.2 e - 2 ea) 0.6 f'c per unit length, ea = Hwe²/(2500 tw), e >= 0.05 tw, the resultant within the middle third, Hwe/tw <= 30 (11.5.1, 11.4: Hwe = 0.75 Hw braced and restrained at both ends, 1.0 Hw otherwise in SAEngine's bracing factors); φ = 0.65 (Table 2.2.2, to verify). 11.6: Vu = Vuc + Vus <= 0.2 f'c (0.8 Lw) tw; Vuc = (0.66 √f'c - 0.21 (Hw/Lw) √f'c) 0.8 Lw tw for Hw/Lw <= 1, else the lesser of that and (0.05 √f'c + 0.1 √f'c / (Hw/Lw - 1)) 0.8 Lw tw, at least 0.17 √f'c 0.8 Lw tw; Vus = ρw fsy 0.8 Lw tw, ρw the lesser of the vertical and horizontal ratios for Hw/Lw <= 1, the horizontal one above; φ = 0.75
